title: 第25章 游仙区扛把子第26章 遇到麻烦
content_zh:
章笑天原本是笑着的，但他的笑容很快便成了尬笑。
只听肖冰冰冷地道：“滚！你他吗以为你是谁？还你的面子，今日，老子必定要将这小子打成残废。”
道上混的，只要红了眼，一般人还真的降伏不了，至少章笑天降服不了。他爸充其量也只是国土局局长。
章笑天被肖冰呵斥，只觉得脸上无光，离开也不是，继续站在这里也不是！
“我来吧。”
还好，这个时候杨量齐走了过来，他直接去到肖冰身边。在肖冰身边小声说了几句。
这一次肖冰没有同呵斥章笑天一样呵斥杨量齐，反而眼神有些凝重。
杨量齐的杨家是航阳市一个比较老的家族，至少有百年历史，虽然只是经商的，但三代人下来，还是积累了不少关系。
“冰哥，看在我杨家的份上，暂且绕过张逸风吧，今后杨家可是我接手的。”
杨量齐再次开口，他也在笑，他的笑容比起章笑天的尬笑可要好多了。
肖冰没有说话，似乎在思考，他还有些犹豫。
就在这时候，一道粗犷霸气的声音传来。
“谁在我这里闹事？”
所有人闻声看去，一位身材高大，皮肤黝黑，脸上有刀疤的男子领着一群人走了过来。
此人走在最前方，气势逼人，一看就知道是长期身居高位。
“刀疤哥。”
不少人看见此人，都恭敬地叫了一声刀疤哥。
刀疤哥，本名康达。梦幻俱乐部的股东，也是游仙区的扛把子。
游仙区是航阳市主城区之一，繁华程度可不是经开区这种郊区能比拟的。就算是肖冰遇到他，也要礼让三分。刀疤的势力，比肖冰要强大一点。
“康总，是冰哥的人。”

大厅经理连忙去到刀疤面前，很明显，这里的动静越来越大，经理不得不打电话通知康达。
“肖冰，怎么在我这里闹这么大。”
刀疤男子看着肖冰，声音平淡，却不怒自威。
肖冰皱眉道：“有人欺负我的女人，我自然要给他一点教训。”

“是谁？”康达询问大厅经理。
“就是那个小子。”大厅经理指着一直站在原地的张逸风。
“是他？”康达看了一眼张逸风，随后淡淡道，“将他扔出去。肖冰，你的事情外面去处理，别在这里打扰我做生意。不然，别怪我不给羊老面子。”
康达的话落，立马从他身后走出两位壮汉，似乎要将张逸风强制赶出去。
一旦张逸风离开了梦幻俱乐部的大门，那还不是我为鱼肉人为刀俎。
“刀疤哥，我是杨量齐，能不能看在我爸的份上，就让这小子待在里面？”
杨量齐的声音再次传来。
“杨家的少爷？可惜，你虽然是杨家的人，却还不是接班人。去喝你的酒，跳你的舞吧。”
康达直接打断了杨量齐的话。杨量齐还不入他的眼。
就在杨量齐尴尬的时候，杜渐的声音传来。
“那我总可以吧？达叔叔，给我一点面子也给我爸一点面子，好吗？”
content_en:
Zhang Xiaotian was originally smiling, but his smile soon turned into an awkward smile.
I just heard Xiao Bing say coldly: "Get out! Who do you think you are? To save your face, I will definitely beat this kid into a cripple today."
As long as the gangsters on the road are jealous, most people really can't surrender, at least Zhang Xiaotian can't surrender. His father is, at best, the director of the Land and Resources Bureau.
Zhang Xiaotian was scolded by Xiao Bing and felt that his face was dull. It didn't matter if he left or if he continued to stand here!
"I'll do it."
Fortunately, Yang Liangqi came over at this time, and he went directly to Xiao Bing. He whispered a few words next to Xiao Bing.
This time, Xiao Bing did not scold Yang Liangqi like he scolded Zhang Xiaotian, but his eyes were serious.
Yang Liangqi's Yang family is an older family in Hangyang City, with a history of at least a hundred years. Although they are only engaged in business, they have accumulated a lot of relationships over three generations.
"Brother Bing, for the sake of my Yang family, let's bypass Zhang Yifeng for now. I will take over the Yang family from now on."
Yang Liangqi spoke again, and he was also smiling. His smile was much better than Zhang Xiaotian's awkward smile.
Xiao Bing didn't speak, he seemed to be thinking, he was still a little hesitant.
At this moment, a rough and domineering voice came.
"Who is causing trouble here?"
Everyone heard the sound and looked around. A tall, dark-skinned man with scars on his face led a group of people over.
This person was walking at the front with an imposing manner, and it was obvious from a glance that he had been in a high position for a long time.
"Brother Scar."
When many people saw this person, they respectfully called Brother Scar.
Brother Scar, whose real name is Kangda. The shareholders of Dream Club are also the leaders of Youxian District.
Youxian District is one of the main urban areas of Hangyang City, and its prosperity is not comparable to that of suburbs like Jingkai District. Even if Xiao Bing meets him, he must be polite. Scar's power is slightly stronger than Xiao Bing's.
"Mr. Kang, he is from Brother Bing."
The lobby manager quickly went to Scar. It was obvious that the noise here was getting louder and louder, and the manager had to call to notify Kunda.
"Xiao Bing, why are you making such a fuss here?"
The scarred man looked at Xiao Bing, his voice was calm but not angry.
Xiao Bing frowned and said, "If someone bullies my woman, I will naturally teach him a lesson."

"Who is it?" Kunda asked the lobby manager.
"That's that boy." The hall manager pointed at Zhang Yifeng, who had been standing there.
"Is it him?" Kangda glanced at Zhang Yifeng, and then said calmly, "Throw him out. Xiao Bing, take care of your affairs outside, and don't disturb my business here. Otherwise, don't blame me for not giving Yang Lao face."
After Kangda finished speaking, two strong men immediately walked out from behind him, seemingly trying to force Zhang Yifeng out.
Once Zhang Yifeng leaves the door of the Dream Club, it will not be me doing anything for the sake of others.
"Brother Scar, I am Yang Liangqi. For the sake of my father, can you please let this kid stay in there?"
Yang Liangqi's voice came again.
"The young master of the Yang family? It's a pity that although you are from the Yang family, you are not the successor yet. Go drink your wine and dance your dance."
Kangda directly interrupted Yang Liangqi. Yang Liangqi didn't even catch his eye.
Just when Yang Liangqi was embarrassed, Du Jian's voice came.
"Then I can do it, right? Uncle Da, give me a little face and give my dad a little face, okay?"
